name: mirage
text:
New report (4:55 PM) and something concrete. Every one of your last 6 bets took about 5.8 seconds from tap to result (5.7 to 6.1 s). Sending the order takes 60-115 ms. Waiting for Novig to finish the order is the rest, about 5.7 s. In our own notes, pregame orders used to finish in about 94 ms, and a delay of around 5 s was only seen on live games. These are pregame bets. A delay like that would explain your symptoms: the ask on screen is gone by the time the order is processed. It would also hit the CNO scanner and by-hand bets alike, which is what you see.
What I can't tell yet is whether Novig added a delay on orders or whether our own reads of the order are slow, since Novig is rate-limiting your phone (429s) when it asks about fills. I'm checking which, from the order's own end time. The NOFILL line didn't appear in the report, so I'm adding it so it does. This is a lead, not a conclusion.
